senses.gloss: m.; pl. צְדָעִים (cmp. צַד) temples. Sifra K’dosh., Par. 3, ch. VI (expl. פאת ראשכם, Lev. XIX, 27) אילו הם הצ׳ מיכן וכ׳ that means the temples on both sides; Macc. 20ᵇ זה המשוה צְדָעָיו וכ׳ he who makes his temples as hairless as the spot back of his ears &c.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 30b:41">Nidd. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>ידיו על שני צדעיו</he> its (the embryo’s) hands rest on its two temples; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14">Lev. R. s. 14</cite>.
